findings.issue: מֵאֵת is the source preposition (taken from the sons of Israel; the statute is from them). «de parte de» in current Latin American Spanish marks acting on their behalf, so Israel becomes the party represented rather than the source.
Plural construct noun plus 3mp suffix is kept as «sus pazes», but that abstract plural does not clearly name the peace-offering noun itself.

notes: Object fronting, 1cs qal verbs, 3mp «los», construct chains, and the repeated Israel phrase otherwise match the tokens.
